note: Source-built from the tip of the tracking branch for scheduled/main runs so safe-docx changes are re-tested without an npm release; pull_request suite runs use pullRequestPinnedCommitSha so required checks are hermetic. install.sh records the concrete commit in build-info.json. To reproduce a past matrix for every event, set pinnedCommitSha (takes precedence over both trackingBranchName and pullRequestPinnedCommitSha).
